description: This Java class defines a REST controller named HealthController in a Spring application. It exposes an endpoint '/health/db' which checks the operational status of a PostgreSQL database by executing a lightweight query typically used for health checks. The class utilizes annotations for Swagger/OpenAPI documentation, dependency injection for DataSource configuration, and handles exceptions to report database connectivity issues. The main functionality includes establishing a connection, executing a simple query, and returning a JSON response indicating the health status.

classes.name: HealthController
classes.description: A REST controller providing health check endpoints for application and database health validation.
